invariants.rationale: tileSet.getTile is called unconditionally if animationElement != null.
tile.getId() is called if animationElement != null.
tileElement.get("animation") is called, so tileElement must not be null.
firstgid is used as an offset and commonly represents a non-negative tile id.
Frame tiles are cast to StaticTiledMapTile after retrieval; either the tile is null or of the correct type to avoid runtime errors.
